target_customer: Developers and venues building computer vision and AR experiences on phones, drones and cameras
problem: Hard to add image recognition and 3D positioning to mobile and drone apps; the YC listing is inconsistent about what Dabble did in 2015.
business_model: Developer tools and platform (specifics not found)

founders.name: Neil Mathew
founders.background_notes: Named as co-founder in the Headout acquisition announcement.

founders.name: Prasenjit Mukherjee
founders.background_notes: YC bio says he started Placenote/Dabble in 2015 building 3D AI for drones and phones.

founders.name: Yan Ma
founders.background_notes: Listed on YC page as The Science Guy.

technical_complexity.rationale: Computer vision and 3D mapping on mobile hardware in 2015 was hard for a three person team.

defensibility.rationale: Some technical depth but no evidence of data lock-in or a strong customer base from sources seen.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not sourced; platform vendors later shipped AR toolkits, but no source ties this to Dabble.

market_need_then: Not established from sources. Headout later described a decade of AR and VR deployments, with developer tools used by 15,000 developers and deployed to over 300,000 devices.

brand_strength.rationale: The name is a common word shared with a Chicago class marketplace and a CGI studio, and later the company used Placenote. No brand press found.

pivots.to: Placenote (3D AI for drones and phones)
pivots.why: Not stated; the YC bio says Placenote/Dabble started in 2015.

outcome_analysis: Dabble (W15) is listed inactive on YC but the team was acquired by Headout in May 2024 after about a decade building computer vision and 3D AI tools. No funding rounds could be verified, and sources mix up different companies named Dabble, so the 2015 product and the path from Dabble to Placenote are unclear. The exit was an acquisition of the team, with no price disclosed.
notes: Several records conflict. The YC page's description differs from third-party listings (a synthetic e-commerce photo studio per Altss; a Toronto CGI studio founded 2021 per CB Insights). A $1M seed in Dec 2015 and the Chicago marketplace (EdSurge 2015) belong to a different company called Dabble and were excluded. CB Insights lists investors Headout, Version One and Y Combinator with no amounts. The Headout article date 2024-05-31 may not be the closing date. dabble.so could not be fetched (domain safety check rate-limited). YC status is Inactive although the team was acquired. Competitor list is empty because the 2015 product is unclear.
